headline: Giving Developers a Way Out? Central Bank Lifts Land Financing Limit of 18 Months for Construction, "Returning to Bank Discretion"; Experts Interpret
summary: The central bank relaxed the second-home mortgage limit to 70% and lifted the 18-month construction limit on land financing. Written commitments to start construction were also removed, easing pressure on small developers.
why: Taiwan's central bank oversees bank lending rules, and changes to mortgage and land-loan limits directly affect property developers and home buyers.
